title: Most of the request, or all of it: the best coding agent on Co-Design Bench
intro: Move across the three views of GPT-6 Astra’s result in the Co-Design Bench preprint, the top score among ten models. Each stop shows the average share of acceptance criteria it passed per task, and the share of tasks where it passed every criterion, as the paper prints them. The gap between the two numbers is the work someone still has to finish.
note: Every figure is from the Co-Design Bench preprint by researchers at Alibaba and several universities, covered by The Decoder on 8 November 2026. All ten models ran in the same Claude Code harness, capped at three hours and 120 turns. Criteria passed is the paper’s strict completion, the average per task of criteria graded Pass. Fully finished is its full-pass rate, the share of tasks with every criterion passed. Grading is by an AI judge in a browser, with a second AI verifier challenging every pass. Each task is one fixed request with no follow-up from the user. The paper also shows that the same model can score very differently in another harness, so these numbers belong to this setup.
